QF.id: XC Investment Products and Market Developments_11

question.text: Which of the following mutual fund categories falls under the 'Solution Oriented' classification by SEBI?

answer.text: Large Cap Fund and Mid Cap Fund
Multi-Asset Allocation Fund and Balanced Advantage Fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Series X-A states that SEBI categorizes open-end mutual fund products into equity, debt, hybrid, solution-oriented and other schemes. Solution-oriented schemes include Retirement Fund and Children's Fund, each with a defined goal and a mandatory lock-in (at least five years or until retirement/majority, as applicable). The Trap: Large/Mid Cap funds are equity categories; Overnight/Liquid funds are debt categories; Multi-Asset and Balanced Advantage are hybrid categories — none of these are solution-oriented. Note: The mandatory lock-in on solution-oriented schemes provides investment discipline and is useful for clients with goal-specific savings such as a child's education or retirement.
